why_these.Piccolo/Trombone/Timpani: page 46 is the first page of the fourth movement and the first page on which any of the three is printed; pages 0, 27, 39 and 42 print none of them. So a staff on a page before 46 named one of them is categorically wrong.
why_these.Tuba: Beethoven 6 HAS NO TUBA, in any movement, so the entry page is unreachable and every Tuba name is impossible on every page. The largest system the document prints is the 14 hand-read at page 54 and it holds no tuba. ⚠️ This name is real and frequent in the run because Litolff abbreviates Tromboni as 'Tb.' and `instruments.lookup('Tb.')` returns Tuba at HIGH confidence — a lexicon collision of the same family as the documented 'Tr.' = Trombe/Tromboni one, not a slot-assignment error.
